name: Ollama Local Model Runner
free_limit: MIT-licensed local model runner and API for downloading and running supported LLMs and embedding models on your own computer or server, with no vendor-imposed local inference request quota.
watch_out: Local inference requires your own CPU/GPU, memory, storage and electricity. Individual model weights have their own licenses and commercial-use terms; hosted Ollama cloud models and third-party APIs may have separate limits and charges. MIT license covers the runner, not every model.
